2024-01-11.name: पौष पुत्रदा एकादशी
2024-01-11.story: Observing this Ekadashi blesses devotees with children and prosperity
2024-01-11.significance: Known for blessing devotees with children, especially for couples seeking progeny
2024-01-11.fasting: Complete fast from sunrise to next day sunrise

2024-01-26.name: शत्तिला एकादशी
2024-01-26.story: This Ekadashi helps in removing sins and grants salvation
2024-01-26.significance: Removes all sins, especially related to falsehood and stealing
2024-01-26.fasting: Complete fast, donation of sesame seeds (til)

2024-02-10.name: जया एकादशी
2024-02-10.story: Victory over enemies and obstacles through divine grace
2024-02-10.significance: Grants victory in all endeavors and removes obstacles

2024-02-25.name: विजया एकादशी
2024-02-25.story: Guarantees victory and success in all spiritual and material pursuits
2024-02-25.significance: Ensures victory in battles, both spiritual and worldly

2024-03-11.name: आमलकी एकादशी
2024-03-11.story: Worship of Amla tree along with Lord Vishnu grants immense merit
2024-03-11.significance: Connected to Amla tree worship, grants health and longevity

2024-03-26.name: पापमोचनी एकादशी
2024-03-26.story: Liberates from all sins accumulated over lifetimes
2024-03-26.significance: Most powerful for removing all types of sins

2024-04-10.name: कामदा एकादशी
2024-04-10.story: Fulfills all desires and grants liberation from ghost yoni
2024-04-10.significance: Fulfills righteous desires and grants spiritual progress
2024-04-10.benefits: Fulfillment of desires and spiritual advancement

2024-04-25.name: वरुथिनी एकादशी
2024-04-25.story: Equivalent to ten years of penance and grants heaven

2024-05-09.name: मोहिनी एकादशी
2024-05-09.story: Removes all sorrows and grants liberation to Vishnuloka
2024-05-09.significance: Most powerful for removing sorrows and sufferings

2024-05-24.name: अपरा एकादशी
2024-05-24.story: Grants immense virtue and destroys great sins
2024-05-24.significance: Known for granting name, fame, and removing major sins

2024-06-08.name: निर्जला एकादशी
2024-06-08.story: Bhima's special Ekadashi - equivalent to all 24 Ekadashis of the year
2024-06-08.significance: Most austere Ekadashi - without water, equals all Ekadashis
2024-06-08.fasting: Complete fast without food and water
2024-06-08.benefits: Merit of all Ekadashis and ultimate salvation

2024-06-23.name: योगिनी एकादशी
2024-06-23.story: Grants power of yoga and spiritual advancement
2024-06-23.significance: Enhances spiritual practices and yogic powers

2024-07-08.name: देवशयनी एकादशी
2024-07-08.story: Lord Vishnu goes to sleep for four months (Chaturmas begins)
2024-07-08.significance: Beginning of Chaturmas, Lord Vishnu's four-month rest
2024-07-08.benefits: Spiritual merit and divine protection during Chaturmas

2024-07-23.name: कामिका एकादशी
2024-07-23.story: Lighting lamp on this day removes all sins and grants virtue
2024-07-23.significance: Special emphasis on lighting lamps and charity
2024-07-23.benefits: Sin removal and accumulation of virtue

2024-08-07.name: श्रावण पुत्रदा एकादशी
2024-08-07.story: Especially powerful for blessing with children
2024-08-07.significance: Second Putrada Ekadashi, grants children and prosperity

2024-08-19.name: अजा एकादशी
2024-08-19.story: Grants spiritual knowledge and higher consciousness
2024-08-19.significance: Eliminates sins and ignorance, grants wisdom

2024-09-06.name: परिवर्तिनी एकादशी
2024-09-06.story: Lord Vishnu changes His sleeping position during Chaturmas
2024-09-06.significance: Lord Vishnu turns to His other side while sleeping
2024-09-06.fasting: Fast with worship of changing Lord
2024-09-06.benefits: Purification of body, mind, and soul

2024-09-21.name: इंदिरा एकादशी
2024-09-21.story: Liberates ancestors from hell and grants them salvation
2024-09-21.significance: Special for ancestors' liberation during Pitru Paksha

2024-10-06.name: पापांकुशा एकादशी
2024-10-06.story: Destroys all sins like a hook (ankusha) removes elephant's stubbornness
2024-10-06.significance: Powerful for destroying all sins and fulfilling desires
2024-10-06.benefits: Complete sin removal and wish fulfillment

2024-10-21.name: राम एकादशी
2024-10-21.story: Grants blessings of both Lord Vishnu and Goddess Lakshmi
2024-10-21.significance: Brings wealth, prosperity, and spiritual elevation

2024-11-05.name: देवउठनी एकादशी
2024-11-05.story: Lord Vishnu wakes up from His four-month sleep (Chaturmas ends)
2024-11-05.significance: End of Chaturmas, Lord Vishnu awakens, auspicious activities resume

2024-11-20.name: उत्पन्ना एकादशी
2024-11-20.story: Birth of Ekadashi Devi to destroy demon Mura
2024-11-20.significance: Celebrates the origin of Ekadashi observance
2024-11-20.benefits: Merit equal to thousand cow donations

2024-12-05.name: मोक्षदा एकादशी
2024-12-05.story: Grants liberation (moksha) from cycle of birth and death
2024-12-05.significance: Most powerful Ekadashi for achieving salvation

2024-12-20.name: सफला एकादशी
2024-12-20.story: Makes all endeavors successful and fruitful
